Summary[]

You unexpectedly overhear two Exiles discussing a lost package during transit, with one of them intent on confronting Lollo Logistics about it.

Upon arriving at Lollo Logistics, you notice the Exile departing after receiving the promise that his package will be retrieved.

You engage in conversation with the Lollo member, named Lumi, who reveals that strange events have been occurring in the Whining Aix's Mire, where her team member lost the package. She asks for your help in recovering it, and to investigate the anomalies, you agree to assist her.

In the dream, you come across Lumi, but it appears she can't hear you.

Steps[]

  1. Go investigate in the Whining Aix's Mire
  2. Follow the Exile
  3. Investigate the depths of Waving Battlefield
    1. (Optional) Ask nearby dockworkers for information
  4. Defeat the enemies
  5. Check on the white cat
  6. Step into the strange gateway
  7. Complete Dreamscape Odyssey: Against All Odds
    1. (Quest continues to Dreamscape Odyssey: Against All Odds)
  8. Talk to Lumi
  9. Talk to the white cat in the carriage
  10. Complete Dreamscape Odyssey: The Mountain and Six Credits
    1. (Quest continues to Dreamscape Odyssey: The Mountain and Six Credits)
  11. Talk to the white cat in the carriage
    1. (Optional) Talk to Zhezhi
  12. Complete Dreamscape Odyssey: Little Warrior's Stage
    1. (Quest continues to Dreamscape Odyssey: Little Warrior's Stage)
  13. Talk to the white cat in the carriage
    1. (Optional) Talk to Encore
  14. Complete Dreamscape Odyssey: Neverending Inferno
    1. (Quest continues to Dreamscape Odyssey: Neverending Inferno)
  15. Talk to the white cat in the carriage
    1. (Optional) Talk to Yinlin

Dialogue[]

Quest Description
A mysterious request, a lost delivery, an opening gateway...

In a realm where dreams and nightmares intertwine, a massive shadow looms around you. It casts a darkness over reality, opening the gateways to dreams across Jinzhou. It asks you, if beauty is fleeting and salvation is futile, why not remain in a dream...
(Head to the designated location)
Cultured Exile: Three days ago, the delivery van reached Waving Battlefield near Whining Aix's Mire!
Cultured Exile: Journeying from the New Federation to Jinzhou, it braved countless trials to arrive at its destination, but alas...
Tianhu: Enough. Explain it in five words.
Cultured Exile: Suspicious! Courier escaped! Package lost!
Tianhu: You're the one who's in charge of this.
Cultured Exile: Y-yes, but Boss...
Tianhu: Whatever you do, do it right and do it clean. That's the Cruising Drake's principle. Finish what you started.
Cultured Exile: Ah, Lollo Logistics! How despicable! Utterly insufferable!
Cultured Exile: I shall reclaim the package myself, that much is clear!
The Exile grunts and storms toward the delivery station.
Rover: (He better not be stirring up any trouble.)
Rover: (No time to call the Patrollers. Let's see what he's up to.)
(Head to the designated location)
Cultured Exile: I've already explained what happened, just give me the package.
Cultured Exile: If you can't, I'll... I'll file a complain with your manager!
Courier: Don't worry, Lollo Logistics always takes care of its customers. We'll definitely get back to you within three business days.
Cultured Exile: Three days!? What if it's broken or lost? Don't you know how serious—
Courier: Oh, if it's broken or lost, you can get a full refund. Plus, the shipping insurance you have covers it. So really, there's nothing to worry about!
Cultured Exile: ...If you say so. Come to think of it, Lollo Logistics has never missed a delivery... In that case, I'll come back later.
The Exile stresses the package's importance, and after a member of Lollo Logistics assures them it will be retrieved, he leaves in reluctance.
Courier: Ahem! We promise, we deliver! Lollo Logistics is at your service! Is there anything I can help you... you with?
Are you new here?
I haven't seen you before.
Courier: Oh, I know your! You're the Rover! A household name in Jinzhou!
Lumi: Hiya! I'm Lumi, the logistics team's good ol' captain. I head up the delivery team.
Lumi: Do you have a package to send, or do you need something else?
That man just now...
Lumi: Oh, he's a regular customer. He might seem unfriendly, but he follows the rules.
Lumi: His package got lost in Whining Aix's Mire. Speaking of that place, something strange is going on there lately, so be careful when you're there, hmm?
What happened exactly?
Tell me about it. Maybe I can help.
Lumi: It's a bit complicated... The lost package is labeled as "high value." My team member Fulei was supposed to deliver it.
Lumi: He mentioned seeing weird things in Whining Aix's Mire, kinda like the stuff happening over in Tacet Fields.
Lumi: I checked it out later and asked around in the port.
Sounds like a risky move.
You do act like a leader.
Lumi: Of course! My team's safety is my top priority!
Lumi: I didn't notice anything unusual lookin' around, but...
Rover: But what?
Lumi: I'm not sure if it's related... but ever since I've returned from the Whining Aix's Mire, I haven't had any dreams.
Lumi's Terminal: We promise, we deliver! We promise, we deliver!
Lumi: Ah, it's my coworker. Sorry, I need to take this call.
Lumi: Yes? What? She's back at work already? But she's injured! ...Okay, please take care of her. Thanks.
What's wrong?
Lumi: It's one of my team members. She crashed while delivering an express package.
Lumi: The doctor told her to rest, but she's already back to work...
Lumi: Hmph... I need to bring her back. She can't be pushin' herself like this.
Lumi: I was planning to search Whining Aix's Mire again, but now...
Lumi: If you happen to be going in that direction, could you keep an eye out for that lost package?
Sure. Leave it to me
Lumi: Amazing! Thank you so much!
As long as I get paid.
Lumi: No problem. I'll make sure you're well rewarded!
(Optional - Inquire nearby dockworker)
Nervous Dockworker: Waving Battlefield? I was there a week ago... on break... Ahem, can't let my boss know this.
Nervous Dockworker: Anyway, I haven't had any dreams ever since then! It's so weird!
Nervous Dockworker: I heard that some researchers screwed up an experiment there. Some even died in an accident... Wait, don't tell me I'm being haunted by their ghosts!
Nervous Dockworker: Oh no, kind ghosts, have mercy on me!
(Optional - Inquire nearby dockworker)
Impetuous Dockworker: Unusual? Huh? What are you talking about?
Impetuous Dockworker: Oh, I know... Someone's deliberately spreading rumors!
Impetuous Dockworker: Port business is booming right now. They want to oust the competition to grab a slice of the pie. That's their game plan!
Impetuous Dockworker: Those rascals must be trying to scare people off to hog all the profits! No chance! This cheap trick won't work on me...
(Optional - Inquire nearby dockworker)
Calm Dockworker: Hmm, now that you mention it, I haven't had any dreams this week.
Calm Dockworker: I used to have nightmares about the day my father left. He was devoured by a Tacet Field and never returned.
Calm Dockworker: But since the dreams stopped, I've been sleeping better than ever.
Calm Dockworker: Maybe it's my father who's been driving them away... Heh, mayybe it's a blessing in disguise?
(Head to the designated location)
Rover: What happened here?
(Head to the designated location)
Rover: The Somnoire gateway must be just ahead...
(Head to the designated location)
Rover: But why is it closed?
(Cutscene plays)
(Cutscene ends)
(Talk to the White Cat)
Strange White Cat: Meow—
Why were you running away?
What happened inside the gateway?
Strange White Cat: Meow... meow...
You want me to go inside?
Strange White Cat: Meow!
(Quest continues to Dreamscape Odyssey: Against All Odds)
(After Against All Odds ends)
(Cutscene plays)
(Cutscene ends)
(Talk to Lumi)
Lumi: Oh, hi! You're here!
Lumi! Thank goodness you're safe!
Lumi: D'ya know what, I had a dream just now! And guess what? You were in it!
Lumi: My team members were asking for help, but I couldn't get to them.
Lumi: I kept getting blocked or showing up too late.
Lumi: I was so worried, thinking they might be disappointed or not need me anymore.
Lumi: But later, I managed to find a girl who'd got into an accident.
Lumi: I don't know how, but I felt like you were guiding me.
Lumi: Talking with her made me see how important it is to support each other.
Lumi: I help my team, and they help me right back.
Lumi: I think that's where I found the strength to escape that nightmare.
Lumi: I wouldn't have realized this without your help. Thank you so much, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍).
(Talk to the Strange White Cat)
Stange White Cat: Thanks a lot...
You can talk!
Stange White Cat: Only a bit...
Stange White Cat: Somnoire breaks into world. My authority... lost.
Stange White Cat: Many places... gateway open. Enter and fight!
I see now. I can help
Stange White Cat: A sharp mind. You are smart.
I saw Lumi. Is she okay?
Stange White Cat: You saw Illusia, not real Lumi. She is safe, don't worry...
Stange White Cat: No energy left. Can't talk. Stop disaster. I trust you...
This is what I do.
You're going to sleep?
(Stroke the white cat)
Stange White Cat: Meow-
Rover: (Lumi hasn't had any dreams since visiting Whining Aix's Mire.)
Rover: (And the Illusia I just saw of her... This abnormal Somnoire seems to be trapping parts of people's consciousness in their dreams.)
Rover: (If this has been going on for a while. Lumi might not be the only one trapped here.)
Rover: (She dreams about her team, but what about the others? I need to find more clues.)
(Quest continues to Dreamscape Odyssey: The Mountain and Six Credits)
(After The Mountain and Six Credits ends)
(Optional - Talk to Zhezhi)
Zhezhi: I was just dreaming. In that dream, I tried my best to paint something new, but no one seemed to like it.
Zhezhi: Instead, they just wanted more copies of my old stuff, treating me like some money machine.
Zhezhi: But you told me to trust myself...
They are using you.
People aren't tools.
Zhezhi: Thank you for supporting me, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍).
No problem, Master Zhezhi.
Zhezhi: Y-you don't have to call me "Master"...
You'll be better. I believe in you.
Zhezhi: I-I'll keep practicing!
(Talk to the white cat in the carriage)
Strange White Cat: Nice job, purr-fect!
Finally you wake up.
You can talk again?
Strange White Cat: Dreams cleansed! Power restored! I can talk now.
Strange White Cat: Somnoire is growing faster... If this keeps up, Solaris will be in danger.
Strange White Cat: Walk through more gateways. Save people from dreams. Fight that person. I'm counting on you!
Strange White Cat: Talking drains my energy. Need to rest now...
Leave it to me.
Strange White Cat: Meow—
Sleepy already? Not again.
Strange White Cat: Meow...
(Stroke the white cat)
Strange White Cat: Meow—
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): (From the looks of it, I'm probably the only one who can enter the Somnoire as I please...)
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): (Besides that cat, the only other people here are the ones trapped in their dreams.)
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): (I will be the one to help them escape.)
(Quest continues to Dreamscape Odyssey: Little Warrior's Stage)
(After Little Warrior's Stage ends)
(Optional - Talk to Encore)
Encore: Hi, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)! Are you ready for Encore's new story?
Ha! Warrior Encore!
What's the story this time?
Encore: Ahem, it goes like this...
Encore: A long, long time ago, there was a Cloud Kingdom, where the amazing warrior Encore lived.
Encore: Then she met you, Traveler Cosmos, Prince Cloudy, and many more new friends.
Encore: Together, they defeated the Dark Cloud Demon!
Sounds just like the last one.
Encore: You're in the story this time! That makes a big difference!
It's a great story, Encore style.
Encore: It's good, right? Stories about adventuring with friends are my favorite!
Encore: I'll tell you a new story next time, don't you worry about that.
(Talk to the white cat in the carriage)
Strange White Cat: It's you...
Strange White Cat: That person. He's awake...
Why are you talking less this time?
Yes, I met the Gatekeeper.
Strange White Cat: Black cat. He's formidable. My power. Limited again. Stop him, Dreamwalker...
Strange White Cat: So tired. Must rest...
Lazy kitty.
Strange White Cat: Meow...
Night, night.
Strange White Cat: Meow—
(Stroke the white cat)
Strange White Cat: Meow—
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): (The cat's weaker than last time. What's worse, the Gatekeeper said the expansion is accelerating...)
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): (I have to stop it before it's too late...)
(Quest continues to Dreamscape Odyssey: Neverending Inferno)
(After Neverending Inferno ends)
